hook: Where did this Mac app even come from?
hookText: Mimoto: where your Mac apps came from

beats.say: Mimoto is a free, open-source Mac app, in beta, that groups your apps by source: App Store, Homebrew, website, built by you, or Apple.
It shows who made each app and what it does, and removes apps with their related files, the right way for where they came from.
Homebrew apps go through brew uninstall, so no leftover records. The name is Japanese for identity, or background.
